title: Haldi + Tiger Balm Knee Compress (Avoid Knee Replacement Surgery)
description: Mix pure unadulterated turmeric with Tiger Balm. In winter, wrap securely around painful knees with a cloth bandage continuously for 5 days. In summer, apply at night and wash in the morning. This deep compress repairs cartilage, saves knees, and avoids knee replacement surgery.
body: Mix pure unadulterated turmeric with Tiger Balm. In winter, wrap securely around painful knees with a cloth bandage continuously for 5 days. In summer, apply at night and wash in the morning. This deep compress repairs cartilage, saves knees, and avoids knee replacement surgery.

title: Wild Lamb Tail Fat (Dumba ki Chaki) for Sciatica (Authentic Hadith)
description: As recorded in authentic prophetic Hadith, rendering the fatty tail (Chaki) of a wild lamb into broth/soup serves as a miraculous cure for sciatic nerve pain (Araq-un-Nisa / Sciatica).
body: As recorded in authentic prophetic Hadith, rendering the fatty tail (Chaki) of a wild lamb into broth/soup serves as a miraculous cure for sciatic nerve pain (Araq-un-Nisa / Sciatica).

title: Jaggery (Gurr) & Raw Onion (Piyaz) for Rapid Sciatica Relief
description: Consuming raw onion paired with unrefined organic Jaggery (Gurr) rapidly resolves sciatic nerve inflammation and lower back pain.
body: Consuming raw onion paired with unrefined organic Jaggery (Gurr) rapidly resolves sciatic nerve inflammation and lower back pain.

title: Ak Leaf & Mustard Oil Joint Compress
description: Gently warm Calotropis (Ak) leaves with mustard oil and wrap over swollen joint tissue overnight to draw out fluid, swelling, and joint stiffness.
